# The ad prices one visit. You are making eight.

> Price a bat, raccoon, squirrel or bird exclusion job from the visits it really takes — daily trap checks, the height the seal is at, attic decontamination, and a reserve against the warranty you sold — instead of the flat removal fee your customer is shopping. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
